purpose: Independent entrance motion layers for New Player Carnival

motion.slogan: Headline slides from left at 80ms; two reward ribbons slide in at 360ms.
motion.character: Rightward offset of 240px, 3-degree rotation, 94% scale settles to original position in 1100ms, delayed 220ms.
